annotation.title_clean: Secure Software Development Practices for Generative AI and Dual-Use Foundation Models: An SSDF Community Profile (NIST SP 800-218A)
annotation.title_en: Secure Software Development Practices for Generative AI and Dual-Use Foundation Models: An SSDF Community Profile (NIST SP 800-218A)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: National Institute of Standards and Technology (NIST); Booth, H.; Souppaya, M.; Vassilev, A.; Ogata, M.; Stanley, M.; Scarfone, K.
annotation.summary_en: NIST SP 800-218A (July 2024) is a community profile of the Secure Software Development Framework (SSDF). It adds security practices, tasks and recommendations specific to developing generative AI and dual-use foundation models, as required by EO 14110. It is aimed at AI model producers, AI system producers and acquirers. It does not cover robotics or physical AI.
key_provisions_or_claims: Augments SSDF 1.1 with AI-model-specific practices across the software development life cycle
Recommends protecting training pipelines, model registries and environments with least privilege
Calls for securing the integrity and provenance of training data and model weights
Suggests human-in-the-loop review for security checks beyond risk thresholds
Maps practices to the NIST AI RMF and the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications as informative references
